trial_analyses.trial_name: 3-arm Trial to Evaluate Pasireotide LAR/Everolimus Alone/in Combination in Patients With Lung/Thymus NET - LUNA Trial
trial_analyses.rationale: The LUNA trial is not relevant to this patient's case as it exclusively enrolled patients with neuroendocrine tumors of the lung and thymus, whereas this patient has a pancreatic primary.
